blind.description: A rectangular wooden window box or planter trough elevated on small angled wooden bracket feet. It is densely packed with stylized dark green leaves and blooming flowers with yellow pistils, featuring a mix of deep red/magenta and pale cream-colored petals. The geometry is clean, continuous, and solid with a stylized cartoon appearance.
blind.from_above: An elongated vertical rectangle filled with tightly clustered red and cream-yellow flowers surrounded by green leaves, framed at the top and bottom by the wooden edges of the planter.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 feet tall (reaching roughly lower-shin height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 3.5 to 4 feet long, and about 1.5 feet wide.
